title: Digital Doubles
fullDescription: A comprehensive showcase of over 20 digital doubles created for film productions. This work highlights the technical and artistic challenges of replicating realistic characters and creatures. Each digital double was meticulously crafted to blend seamlessly with live-action footage, enhancing cinematic realism.
